name: the Solanne
identity: Sunny harbor folk: sailors, shipwrights, fishers and lens-grinders who keep the Wide's lighthouses lit.
architecture: Whitewashed houses with blue shutters stacked up the cliffs, lighthouses crowned with great glass lenses, and markets spilling along the quays.

festivals.name: the Regatta of Lights
festivals.description: Boats race across the bay at dusk with lanterns on their masts, and the harbor cheers for whoever is losing.

festivals.name: Lens Day
festivals.description: The lighthouse lenses are polished until they sing, and the whole town picnics on the rocks below.

festivals.name: the Homecoming Tide
festivals.description: When the fishing fleet returns, everyone meets it at the quay with bread, music and dry socks.

values: never turning a stranger away from the quay
pride: Their lighthouses, which guided ships even through the Hush, and Captain Velisa Corro.

makersMarks: a tiny lighthouse etched into the metal
a knot of blue thread wound around the grip
the maker's ship-name stamped backward, for luck

relations.note: Steady trade partners who still dispute who invented the lighthouse lens and who invented the sun-mirror.
The Great Wager: Captain Corro by sea against Hjalla Osvik on foot. Both peoples follow the letters closely.
Salt and glass inland, wool and cheese back to the coast.
